name: DMLeducate
author: discountsmania

sections.description:
DMLeducate combines a learning management system (LMS) with school management, and keeps the two in sync. Sell or give away courses, enrol students, and have their quiz results flow straight into your school gradebook, report cards and results.

Learning

  • Courses with sections, lessons and quizzes (drag-and-drop curriculum builder)
  • Lesson files: attach PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, audio, video or ZIP files, or add files by link (Google Drive, Dropbox, any URL). Downloads are checked against the student’s access.
  • Quizzes with single, multiple-choice and true/false questions, pass mark, time limit and retake limits
  • Student dashboard with progress, orders and results
  • Course cards with Enrol / Start / Continue buttons
  • Bank-transfer checkout: show your bank details, approve orders when paid, or enrol students manually
  • Editable e-mail notifications (welcome, enrolment, course finished, order, payment, absence alert, results ready) with placeholders and a branded template
  • Instructor, Teacher and Student roles; REST API

School management

  • Classes, subjects, terms/sessions, student records (CSV import, parent/guardian details, login accounts)
  • Attendance, assessments and score sheet
  • Weighted grade calculator, grade scale, GPA, pass mark and class positions
  • Report cards with school logo, teacher comment and uploadable principal / class teacher signatures
  • Results released after the term ends, with an End session button
  • Public grade calculator shortcode

Everything synced

Link a course to a class, subject and term. When someone enrols (paid, free or manual) they become a student of that class. Each curriculum section can feed its own subject, quiz results become scores, and students can see their results once the session ends. Placing a student in a class can also enrol them in that class’s courses.

DMLeducate Pro (optional, separate paid add-on)

PDF certificates with school logo, e-stamp, e-signature and GPA, online payments (Stripe, Paystack, PayPal, Flutterwave) and EbulkSMS notifications are available in the separate DMLeducate Pro plugin. This plugin works fully without it.

Shortcodes

  • [dmle_courses] – course catalogue
  • [dmle_dashboard] – student dashboard
  • [dmle_results] – results and report cards for students and parents
  • [dmle_grade_calculator] – public grade calculator
  • [dmle_login] and [dmle_register] – login and registration forms

Quick setup

  1. Settings: go to DMLeducate > Settings. Set your currency, bank transfer details and notification emails.
  2. Session and term: under School, add the academic session and its terms, then choose the current term.
  3. Classes and subjects: create your classes, then add the subjects each class studies.
  4. First course: go to Courses > Add New. Build the curriculum with sections, lessons and quizzes, set the price, then link the course to a class, subject and term.
  5. Enrolment: a student who pays, or whom you activate manually, is enrolled and added to the linked class automatically.
  6. Results: record assessments and attendance, then results and report cards are released after the term ends.

Full guide for every module: https://www.discountsmania.com.ng/dmleducate/

External services

When a lesson uses a video URL, the plugin asks the video provider (for example YouTube or Vimeo) for its embed code through WordPress’s built-in oEmbed. Only the video URL is sent. Linked files you add to a lesson are opened directly by the student’s browser on the site you link to. No other external services are used by this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dmleducate folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin. Pages for Courses, Student Dashboard and My Results are created automatically.
  3. Go to DMLeducate > Settings to set your currency and bank details.
  4. Create classes and a term under School, then create your first course. See the documentation at https://www.discountsmania.com.ng/dmleducate/
sections.faq:
Do I need the Pro add-on?

No. Courses, enrolment, bank-transfer orders, manual enrolment, school management, e-mail notifications and results are all free. Pro adds certificates, online payments and SMS.

How do students pay?

By bank transfer: they place an order, you approve it, and they are enrolled. You can also enrol students manually. Online card payments need the Pro add-on.

How does a paid course make someone a student?

Link the course to a class under “School link” in the course editor. Whenever that course enrols someone, a student record is created in that class.

When do students see their results?

By default after the term ends. Change this under DMLeducate > Settings > Results release, or click End session on a term to release results immediately.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes. Front-end screens are shortcodes and use their own lightweight styles.

Where is my data stored?

In your own WordPress database. The plugin does not send data to the developer.
